question: 6 A 100-mm prick punch with a 7-mm diameter body could have a 2.5-mm diameter point ground to an angle of __________.
solution:
The correct answer is __30°.__

**__Key Points__**

__
 
• The prick punch is a tool used for marking points or locations on a workpiece before drilling or machining.
 
• A 100-mm prick punch with a 7-mm diameter body typically has a pointed end ground to a specific angle for precise marking.
 
• The point ground to an angle of 30°__ ensures sharper and more accurate indentations.
 
• Such a smaller angle is ideal for precision tasks, particularly in metalworking.

**__Additional Information__**

 
• **Prick Punch:**

 
 
• A prick punch is commonly used in layout and metalworking to mark the location of holes to be drilled.
 
• The tip is ground to a fine point, typically at an angle, depending on the intended use.
 
 
 
• **Other Punch Types:**
 
 
• Center Punch: Used to create a dimple for guiding a drill bit.
 
• Drift Punch: Used to align or enlarge holes in metal.
 
• Pin Punch: Used to drive pins out of holes.
